name: Color Picker
purpose: Provide complete headless color selection with one shared color model, accessible area and channel interaction, alpha, format conversion, presets, optional positioned content, form submission, and progressive screen sampling.
useWhen: A form, editor, or settings surface needs one selectable and editable color.

avoidWhen.condition: The interface only previews a color.
The product needs saved palettes, automatic names, contrast analysis, gradients, or persistence.
avoidWhen.useInstead: application or dedicated higher-layer state composed around Color Picker

composition: Place Label and the editable controls inside Root; include HiddenInput when a named value must submit.
For an inline picker set inline and compose Area plus channel controls directly; for a popup compose Trigger, Positioner, and Content.
Build each ChannelSlider from Track and Thumb; optional Label and ValueText inherit the parent channel.
Build presets from SwatchGroup, SwatchTrigger, Swatch, and optional SwatchIndicator; Brick owns the visible checkmark.

rules.statement: Keep color value, format, area, channels, alpha, and presets on the same ColorPicker.Root model.
Give the picker, channel controls, and presets meaningful accessible names and never communicate selection by color alone.
Use onValueChangeEnd for expensive work that should wait for a pointer drag, committed channel input, or eyedropper completion; area and slider keyboard steps use the ordinary value-change event.
Merge Atom-provided inline styles and CSS variables instead of replacing area, slider, thumb, positioning, or color-math styles.
Treat EyeDropper and NativeInput as progressive platform features; NativeInput is opaque-only and unsupported or cancelled EyeDropper use is a no-op.
Use visual swatch shapes through Brick Color Swatch styling rather than adding shape behavior to Atom Root.

commonMistakes.mistake: Reimplementing color conversion or pointer math in Brick or an application.
commonMistakes.correction: Compose the Atom area, channel, and format parts.

commonMistakes.mistake: Storing saved colors inside Color Picker.
commonMistakes.correction: Store the palette in application state and render it through SwatchTrigger.

commonMistakes.mistake: Presenting NativeInput as the full picker.
commonMistakes.correction: Label it as the browser-owned opaque chooser or use the complete area/channel anatomy.

validation: Test pointer, touch, arrow/Page/Home/End keys, pointer-drag completion, LTR/RTL, alpha, all formats, controlled/uncontrolled state, popup dismissal, swatch selection, disabled/read-only behavior, external form association, and reset.
Verify EyeDropper support, success, cancellation, and unsupported behavior in a secure browser context without claiming unavailable engines.
Verify the styled layer in narrow, zoomed, light/dark, and forced-color modes.
